_comment: Facts that came with community contributions (app issues), checked against the mods' own files.

installNotes+: With Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom (ATB) turn off its MCT option "Swap NKari and Snikch" (on by default): ATB needs N'Kari to start in Ulthuan. The other swaps are separate options and can stay on (read from the pack's MCT settings; a player's flag, 2026-11-17).

mods.suggestOnly: Rearms the whole Beastmen roster with guns – a gameplay change a player adds by choice, not part of a Play size (a player of Community Beastmen – Extended, 2026-11-19, the maintainer agrees).
knownIssues+: With Community Beastmen (Extended list, game 9.0.5) a player saw badly deformed unit models and the ammunition bar on melee units such as Ungor Spearmen; switched off, the campaign ran fine (report with screenshots, 2026-11-19).
